compendium.summary: Preloaded emergency spell with precise trigger planning.
warnings: The Compendium index is an operating reference, not replacement spell text. Confirm the active D&D Beyond entry before casting.
Component planning: Excellent safety tech. Buy/craft before high-level dangerous arcs.
Pre-cast gate: Write a perceivable, objective trigger and test the loaded spell's target and timing.
Failure state: Ambiguous trigger, premature activation, or concentration replacing the spell already winning the fight.
Safe operating default: Use a narrow emergency trigger and rehearse the consequence, not only the activation.
